title: MMDA wants EDSA road repair barriers removed to prevent accidents
summary: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority on Thursday said it has requested the Department of Public Works and Highways to remove all barriers installed along EDSA for ongoing road rehabilitation…

blocks.text: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority on Thursday said it has requested the Department of Public Works and Highways to remove all barriers installed along EDSA for ongoing road rehabilitation works, citing safety concerns and the risk of road accidents.
